assembly.doc: Assemble and return a composed block structure for the current hub. Implementation details are resolved at runtime by the platform.

content.doc: Retrieve block content for a given hashtag, device, and language. Resolves the correct JSON file (published, draft, or versioned) and delivers it via an nginx internal redirect (X-Accel-Redirect). Falls back across languages and devices when the exact file is not found.

name.doc: Block identifier. Resolved in order: name, then hashtag, then id.

hashtag.doc: Block hashtag identifier. Used when name is not provided.

id.doc: Block ID. Used as fallback when neither name nor hashtag is provided. At least one of name, hashtag, or id must be present.

status.doc: Content status filter. Use published to retrieve the online version or draft to retrieve the current draft.

serial.doc: History version serial number. When greater than 0, retrieves the specific versioned JSON file.

file.doc: Block JSON content delivered as text/plain via nginx X-Accel-Redirect. Response includes Content-Disposition, Cache-Control, and Content-Length headers.

errors.message: No content file found for the requested hashtag, device, and language combination

copy.doc: Copy a versioned block history entry to a new page or as a new revision. Writes the copied JSON file to the filesystem under the destination locale and device path, updating all meta fields accordingly.

history_id.doc: ID of the source history entry to copy from

locale.doc: Target locale code for the copied content (e.g. fr, en)

hashtag.doc: Hashtag for the destination block. If empty, the source block hashtag is reused.

option.doc: Copy mode: 0 = default, 1 = copy as new page, 2 = copy as new revision history

serial.doc: Serial number assigned to the copied version

device.doc: Device type of the copied entry

errors.message: A block with the given hashtag already exists
Confirmation required to copy as a new page
Copy operation failed due to an internal error

delete.doc: Delete a block entry for a specific device and locale. The block must not be in published state; call unpublish first if needed. On success, removes the corresponding filesystem directory for the given device and locale.

locale.doc: Locale code of the block version to delete (e.g. fr, en)

device.doc: Device type of the block version to delete

lang.doc: Locale of the deleted block version

errors.message: Block must be unpublished before it can be deleted

exists.doc: Check whether a block identified by a string value exists. Uses the block_exists stored procedure and returns the result directly.

value.doc: Primary lookup value. Falls back to string if not provided.

string.doc: String to check for existence. Defaults to value when not provided.

data.doc: Result from the block_exists stored procedure indicating whether the block exists

filter.doc: List platform block models from the yellow-page database, paginated. Calls the yp.plf_list_models stored procedure.

data.doc: Paginated list of platform block models

history.doc: Retrieve the edit history log for a block, optionally filtered by device, language, month, and year. Calls the block_history_log stored procedure.

id.doc: Block ID to retrieve history for

month.doc: Month filter (1-12). When non-zero, year becomes required.

year.doc: Year filter. Required when month is non-zero.

lang.doc: Language code filter. Defaults to the hub default language.

data.doc: Paginated history log entries for the block

errors.message: year is required when month is non-zero

info.doc: Get metadata information for a block identified by its hashtag. Calls the block_info stored procedure.

hashtag.doc: Hashtag identifier of the block to retrieve info for

data.doc: Block metadata record returned by the block_info stored procedure

list.doc: List blocks filtered by editor type, with pagination and sort order. Calls the block_list stored procedure.

order.doc: Sort order: D for descending, A for ascending

list_by.doc: List blocks by locale and published state, with optional name filter, sort field, sort direction, and pagination. Calls the block_get_draft_publish stored procedure.

locale.doc: Locale code to filter blocks by (e.g. fr, en). Falls back to request language.

published.doc: Publication state filter. Passed directly to the stored procedure.

data.doc: Filtered and paginated list of block records

log.doc: Retrieve the global block activity log, paginated and sorted. Calls the block_log stored procedure.

order.doc: Sort order: D for descending, A for ascending

purge.doc: Permanently delete a block and remove its entire filesystem directory. Calls the block_purge stored procedure, then removes the block root directory via fsx.remove.

id.doc: Block ID or hashtag to purge

data.doc: Result data returned by the block_purge stored procedure after filesystem cleanup

errors.message: Purge failed because the block record has no ID

rename.doc: Rename a block by updating its hashtag in the database and rewriting the hashtag field in all existing JSON content files on the filesystem. Calls the block_rename_new stored procedure.

name.doc: New hashtag value. Takes precedence over hashtag when provided.

hashtag.doc: New hashtag value. Required when name is not provided.

data.doc: Updated block record with the new hashtag

errors.message: A block with the requested hashtag already exists
Block record returned by the procedure is empty or invalid

search.doc: Full-text search over blocks. Hyphens in the search string are replaced with spaces before calling the block_search stored procedure.

string.doc: Search string. Hyphens are replaced with spaces before the query. Defaults to wildcard.

data.doc: Paginated search results from the block_search stored procedure

store.doc: Create or update a block content version. Writes the letc JSON content object to the filesystem under the resolved device and language path, creates symlinks for current and optionally online versions, updates the full-text search index via block_index, and dispatches to block_save_int or block_update_new depending on the status flag.

id.doc: Block ID. When 0 or absent, a new block is created.

hashtag.doc: Block hashtag. Takes precedence from name; required when name is not provided and id is 0.

name.doc: Block name used as the hashtag. Takes precedence over hashtag.

letc.doc: Block content object to persist. Written to the filesystem as a JSON file. Meta fields (device, lang, serial, id, hashtag) are injected automatically.

lang.doc: Target language code. Defaults to the hub default language.

serial.doc: Version serial number. Required when id is non-zero.

status.doc: Publication status controlling which stored procedure branch is executed.

version.doc: Schema version of the letc format. Defaults to the platform LETC version constant.

comment.doc: Optional change comment for the version

active.doc: Serial number of the saved version, used as the JSON filename

errors.message: A block with the requested hashtag already exists

unpublish.doc: Unpublish a block for a specific device and locale. Verifies the block is currently published, removes the online.json symlink, and re-links the current.json to the previous history entry via the block_unpublish stored procedure.

locale.doc: Locale code of the block version to unpublish (e.g. fr, en)

device.doc: Device type of the block version to unpublish

data.doc: Updated block record returned by the block_unpublish stored procedure

errors.message: Block is not currently in published state and cannot be unpublished
